decisions.reason: Its home-page prominence and direct extension of the core cloud messaging business suggest results at or above aspiration levels, and the firm's growth and hiring imply enough slack to retain it.
A dedicated page and a specific customer reference indicate satisfactory acceptance in adjacent document workflows, so a growing R&D-active firm would likely keep it.
Even with lower visibility, it leverages the firm's established multi-channel communications capabilities and likely performs well enough to avoid problemistic search away from it.
As an incremental fax optimization feature it faces some risk of being folded into broader services, but its close fit with the firm's installed fax-related offer supports retention.
Threat protection reinforces the firm's secure-communications value proposition, and in a growing firm with some slack it is more likely to be kept unless results clearly disappoint.
